props.name: value
props.description: Controlled ids. In multiple mode these are leaf ids; a branch is checked when all its leaves are.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the chosen ids, in tree order.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Checkboxes and many values, instead of one.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the trigger and the tree.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown on the trigger while nothing is chosen.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Show a filter above the tree that reveals matching branches.

props.name: maxChips
props.description: Chips shown on the trigger before the rest collapse into “+N”.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Ids expanded when the panel first opens.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control as failing validation.

props.name: id
props.description: Goes on the trigger, so a Field label points at it.
